author: Ogrey
body:
Okay, so in school, when I have nothing to do, coughalwayscough, I usually spend my time determining which maps to make, how to make them, which style, how should the gameplay be, which cool name should I give it, etc.
So I have just now decided to make a thread about it, my map ideas, but I also thought about something else!
Why don't you guys submit your map ideas here (ideas for maps you have that you wish to be built, however you aren't good building, or you don't have time, etc) so I give them a try!
Here's the list:

Nebula
(x) Justice
(x) Formorgar
( ) Cleyra
( ) Justice 2
( ) Formorgar 2
( ) Overgrown
( ) Justice 3
( ) Cormaya
( ) Phoenix
( ) Burmecia
( ) Historia

Nexus
(x) Scribblewood
(x) Oeilvert
(x) Dredmor
(x) Dragonblaze Peaks
(x) Amazon 2
( ) Turbine
( ) Dustbowl 1
( ) Dustbowl 2
( ) Dustbowl 3
( ) Yalahar
( ) Eclipse
( ) Secret Laboratory
( ) Studio
( ) Saffron City
( ) Arcturus
( ) Thais
( ) Carlin
( ) Venore
( ) Fibula
( ) The Division 3

Control the Hill
(x) Fairy Hills
( ) Oeilvert: CTH
( ) Sky Tower
( ) Sunfall Shores
( ) Tomato Soup

The Walls
( ) Miracle
( ) Graveyard
( ) Greece's Pieces


PLEASE, leave your suggestions behind, I'll take them into consideration!
Thanks for taking your time!
